  {"step":2,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":76,"var":"st","code":"st = fu_struct_uswid_parse_stream(stream, offset, error);","note":"The parser reads the crafted header from the input stream into a structured object."},
  {"step":3,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":91,"var":"hdrsz","code":"hdrsz = fu_struct_uswid_get_hdrsz(st);","note":"The header size is taken from the attacker-controlled header and later used as the payload start offset."},
  {"step":4,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":92,"var":"payloadsz","code":"payloadsz = fu_struct_uswid_get_payloadsz(st);","note":"The payload length is attacker-controlled and determines how many bytes are read from the stream."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":110,"var":"priv->compression","code":"priv->compression = FU_USWID_PAYLOAD_COMPRESSION_NONE;","note":"With hdrver 3 and flags clear, the parser selects the uncompressed payload path."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":137,"var":"payload","code":"payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);","note":"The parser reads exactly payloadsz bytes starting at offset+hdrsz from the attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":151,"var":"offset_tmp","code":"for (gsize offset_tmp = 0; offset_tmp < payloadsz;) {","note":"The code iterates over the returned payload buffer and assumes each embedded coSWID object advances the cursor."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c","function":"fu_uswid_firmware_parse","line":156,"var":"fw2","code":"fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);","note":"A slice of the payload is handed to the coSWID parser; if the embedded object is malformed, downstream parsing can overread while decoding it."}
]

from pathlib import Path
import struct
magic = bytes.fromhex('53424F4DD6BA2EACA3E67A52AAEE3BAF')
